headline: Genta Drew The Royal Oak. And The Nautilus?
stop_reason: Attempt 4 stopped without rendering. The two layout failures from the last review are template limits, not copy problems: (1) the slide 1 cover photo credit is tiny, faint and top-right over the busy part of the portrait; (2) the slide 5 Nautilus photo is dimmed so heavily the watch is barely visible, and its text sits over the dial. Per the lessons file and the editor rules, I cannot edit templates, so I did not re-render. Also, the cover credit reads 'Photo: Unknown' in earlier notes; any photo whose author is Unknown or blank has no valid rights entry and must be dropped, not credited. Owner decision needed: (a) allow a template change for credit placement (larger, solid backing, clear of the portrait) and a lighter dim on A-photo/D-cover photo slides that keeps the Nautilus visible, or (b) drop the portrait/Nautilus photos and run a typographic version. Research is sound per the last review (Sotheby's, Gear Patrol and Wikipedia name Genta as designer of both; Nautilus 1976 confirmed; napkin story dropped as single-outlet).
